name: Amaya Rei
source:
An aspiring musician, she bets everything on playing the viola. Rei does not only have absolute confidence in her own talents, but also in her future as a musician and being able to become a big name. But because she has financial problems, Rei has her eye on only rich guys and tries to lure them with her charms in order to get financial assistance. Basically, she is a gold digger. Having said that, she realizes sometimes that she goes too far. Rei has a strong character, and is very straightforward when it comes to her emotions, and expresses what she is feeling. Ultimately, she is a very kind girl.

"If you think about it, money is pretty important, isn't it?"
